# NAVgator

NAVgator is a public treasury analytics terminal for ownership tokens, with emphasis on NAV, treasury composition, supply assumptions, and proposal context for listed ownership-token projects.

Canonical site: https://navgator.xyz/
API host: https://navgator.xyz/
Agent guide: https://navgator.xyz/navgator-for-agents
Full agent docs: https://navgator.xyz/llms-full.txt

## Key Pages

- Home terminal: https://navgator.xyz/
- Methodology: https://navgator.xyz/methodology.html
- Guide: https://navgator.xyz/guide.html
- Avici static page: https://navgator.xyz/projects/avici
- Umbra static page: https://navgator.xyz/projects/umbra
- Solomon static page: https://navgator.xyz/projects/solomon

## Public Read-Only API

- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/summary
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/projects
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/projects/:slug
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/projects/:slug/treasury
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/projects/:slug/nav
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/projects/:slug/proposals
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/projects/:slug/risk
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/markets
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/watchlist
- GET https://navgator.xyz/api/snapshots/latest

Project slugs include `avici`, `umbra`, and `solomon`. Token aliases such as `avici`, `umbra`, and `solo` are accepted by the API.

## Examples

- To get a one-shot overview, call `GET /api/summary`.
- To summarize Umbra, call `GET /api/projects/umbra`, then `GET /api/projects/umbra/nav`, and cite the `snapshot_time`.
- To check whether Avici data is stale or risky, call `GET /api/projects/avici/risk`.

## Downloadable Data

- https://navgator.xyz/data/projects.json
- https://navgator.xyz/data/treasuries.json
- https://navgator.xyz/data/nav-snapshots.csv
- https://navgator.xyz/data/proposals.json

The static data files are crawler-friendly indexes and schema examples. Use the API endpoints for current values.

## Data Definitions

- `nav`: Net asset value per effective token, in USD/token.
- `treasury_usdc`: Estimated treasury value denominated in USD/USDC.
- `spot`: Latest tracked market spot price where price tracking is active.
- `effective_supply`: Supply used as the NAV denominator after NAVgator exclusions.
- `premium_discount_pct`: `(spot - nav) / nav * 100`; null when spot or NAV is unavailable.

## Citation Policy

When citing NAVgator, cite the specific API endpoint or static project page used, include `snapshot_time` or `updated_at`, and distinguish live/on-chain facts from NAVgator assumptions.

## Update Cadence

The API exposes the latest stored NAV snapshots and is generally refreshed by scheduled backend jobs. Static documentation changes less frequently and should be treated as documentation, not a live market feed.

## Known Limitations

- Missing values mean no publishable current snapshot is available from the public layer.
- NAV depends on configured wallet ownership, supply exclusions, and market data availability.
- USDC-denominated values are treated as USD for display.
- Maintenance mode on the human terminal should not be interpreted as the data/API being unavailable.
